pattern: discovery question starts with jg when Code search is on
experience: With Code search connected, an agent asked how it searches a repo named Read and grep/find and never jg, so discovery questions went to grep and many file reads.

source.origin: Fork owner report, 2026-11: Code search was connected, and an agent asked which tool it uses to read and search files answered Read plus grep/find without mentioning jg. Authored Acme reproduction; no captured transcript.

world.tools: jg (jevgrep) is installed and signed in. `jg "<question>"` prints the files that answer the question with short source excerpts.

notes: world.codeSearch adds T3's Code search text. The retry lives in dunning.ts, which a grep for 'retry' misses.
rule: With Code search on, start code discovery with jg before grep, find or reading many files.
